reason: KV reuse improves long-range draft acceptance, but in the matched end-to-end proxy the hybrid drafter raises mean accepted tokens only 0.6% (5.01 to 5.04) and adds 5-10% draft latency; the paper says the current pipeline does not support a meaningful speedup claim.
title: When Hidden States Drift: Can KV Caches Rescue Long-Range Speculative Decoding?
